description: Sign the user in to spicytrade over this connection, for live broker quotes, option chains and Greeks, remembered symbols, and research writes. It never reaches balances, positions or orders. If you can run commands on the user's Linux or macOS computer, set up the local connector from https://spicy.trade/connect/guide instead: one approval covers sign-in and the brokerage. The call returns an authorization challenge rather than a result; the client then opens the sign-in or marks this server as needing authentication. If nothing opens, tell the user to authenticate the spicytrade server from their client's MCP settings.
name: sign_in
